description:
Deprecated alias of fareseal_export. Same data; use the /v1/fareseal/ path. Original description follows.

Free bulk read of the commons — the raw record is never paywalled. Every
row carries a tollbooth document exactly as its site signed it — the
`receipt` (kind=receipts) or `snapshot` (kind=reports) object, Ed25519
over RFC 8785 JCS of that document minus `sig`, key = its own `site` —
beside a `_commons` envelope naming the tier and vouching domain (the
envelope is not signed). Nothing in a row requires trusting TunnelMind.

Use this tool when:
- You want the raw record behind the stats, or to verify it yourself.
- You are building your own exhibit or comparison over attested sites.

Returns:
- `rows[]`: `{_commons: {tier, domain, received_at}, receipt | snapshot}`.
- `rows_returned`, `limit`, `capped` (true when more rows follow this
  page, not merely when the page is full), `next_after` (id of the last
  row emitted; null when this page is the last).
- Paging: follow `next_after` as `after=` until `capped` is false. The
  NDJSON download carries the same as `x-commons-capped` and
  `x-commons-next-after` headers.

Cost:
- Counts as one request against the daily rate limit. Past days cached 1h.

Latency:
- Typical: <200ms cached; up to ~1s on a cache miss for a busy day.

after.description: The `next_after` of the previous page; returns rows with id after it. Omit for the first page.

day.description: UTC day, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to yesterday.

format.description: json for the {ok,data} envelope (what this tool reads); omit for the NDJSON download.

limit.description: Rows to return (JSON form defaults to 200; the NDJSON download at the same URL defaults to 5000).

name: tollbooth_export
